hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.html|*.css|*.js) jq -n --arg f "$f" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse", additionalContext: ("Reminder: " + $f + " is front-end code. Check it against fes-coding-standards before finishing this turn: external CSS only (no inline style/<style>), hex/rgba colors only, BEM class names, box-sizing:border-box reset, responsive breakpoints at 480/768/1200px, semantic HTML with paired label/for, lucide icons not emoji/hand-rolled SVG.")}}' ;; esac; }
